quote.text: There is no great genius without tincture of madness.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Much like the unpredictable brilliance in genius, our children sometimes exhibit wild, unexplained behaviors; embrace these moments as the fertile soil in which innovative thought and character are nurtured.
    • In guiding them, recognize that a touch of what may seem “madness” can be the spark of creativity and resilience—qualities that, when tempered with wisdom, lead to true greatness.
  • Leadership:
    • True leadership often requires venturing beyond the safe confines of conventional thought, allowing for that spark of madness to inspire bold decisions and radical innovation.
    • By embracing the unconventional ideas of your team—and even your own stray thoughts—you cultivate an environment where disciplined freedom breeds the ingenuity necessary for profound progress.
  • Product Management:
    • Just as the great genius blends reason with a pinch of madness, successful product management involves merging meticulous strategy with daring creativity to unlock breakthrough innovations.
    • Encourage the kind of out-of-the-box thinking that might initially seem chaotic; by channeling that energy with careful planning and execution, you transform wild ideas into transformative solutions.
